_what: THE APPROVED TAXONOMY OF THE COMMUNITY LAYER AND THE EVENT CATEGORIES, machine readable. Close-out C18 FINAL, 7 September 2026, owner decision of that day: the community layer is an approved, deliberate feature added during the build and it stays; nothing is removed; where the platform is ahead of the scope the scope is updated, where the scope is ahead the platform is built. This file is the one list scripts/guards/community-layer-protected.mjs judges the source and the database against, and docs/EventLinqs_Scope_v5-Addendum-A-Community-Layer.md is its prose. Enumerated on 7 September 2026 from src/lib/communities/data.ts (the list every live surface reads), src/lib/faiths/data.ts, src/lib/hero-categories.ts and public.event_categories on production (read only), never typed from memory.

communityCityMatrix._what: Every community has a page for every city in src/lib/cities/data.ts getAllCities(): 21 x 20 = 420 pages at /community/[community]/[city], all published in the sitemap.

categories._what: public.event_categories, the platform's real category taxonomy (22 slugs on production and TEST, identical), each forwarded by /categories/[slug] to /events?category=[slug]. inScopeV5 names the Scope v5 line 351 category the slug implements; null marks an approved addition beyond the scope.
